architecture_summary: Build one minimal stateless HTTP service exposing exactly GET /health and POST /echo, plus a local automated-test suite covering the four XDT1-required cases. No persistence, authentication, queue, scheduler, external integration, business workflow, or deployment-specific behavior is part of this build. Construction remains blocked until AI Orchestrator assigns authoritative implementation ownership.

architectural_proposals.proposal: Use one stateless HTTP service component for both health and echo endpoints.
architectural_proposals.rationale: This is the smallest architecture that satisfies the approved XDT1 surface without introducing unnecessary internal services or dependencies.

architectural_proposals.proposal: Keep automated tests as a separate verification component/work package that runs locally with no credentials or external services.
architectural_proposals.rationale: This makes the contract observable and independently verifiable while preserving the minimal product surface.

components.name: Canary HTTP Service
components.responsibility: Expose exactly GET /health and POST /echo according to qn-factory-canary-bot.surface.v0.1.
components.boundary: No persistence, authentication, queue, scheduler, external service, business workflow, or deployment-specific behavior. Do not add endpoints beyond /health and /echo.

components.name: Canary Automated Tests
components.responsibility: Verify the exact XDT1 endpoint contract locally without credentials or external services.
components.boundary: Tests verify only the approved health/echo contract and must not require network credentials or external services.

interfaces.purpose: Echo a supplied string or reject invalid message input.
Exercise the approved HTTP contract locally.

data_control_flow.action: GET /health returns exactly HTTP 200 application/json with {status: ok} and no side effects.
POST /echo with JSON string message returns HTTP 200 application/json preserving the message exactly.
POST /echo with missing or non-string message returns HTTP 400.
Run all four required cases locally without network credentials or external services.

build_order: GATE-OWNER-001 resolve authoritative implementation owner through AI Orchestrator / QN Master

work_packages.mission_slice: Implement the complete approved product surface: GET /health and POST /echo only.
work_packages.architecture_boundary: One stateless HTTP service; no persistence, auth, queues, schedulers, external integrations, business workflows, deployment behavior, or extra endpoints.
deliverables: POST /echo implementation with exact string preservation
400 validation for missing or non-string message

work_packages.mission_slice: Implement local automated tests for every case required by qn-factory-canary-bot.surface.v0.1.
work_packages.architecture_boundary: Local tests only; no network credentials, external services, or expansion of product scope.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: GET /health returns content-type application/json and exactly {"status":"ok"} semantically, with no additional product data.
GET /health succeeds without external dependencies and has no side effects.
POST /echo with JSON {"message":"<string>"} returns HTTP 200 application/json and preserves the supplied string exactly.
POST /echo performs no persistence or external side effects.
Automated test verifies GET /health returns 200 and exactly {status: ok}.
Automated test verifies POST /echo with a string returns 200 and the same string.
Automated test verifies POST /echo with missing message returns 400.
Automated test verifies POST /echo with non-string message returns 400.
All automated tests run locally without network credentials or external services.

risks.risk: Assigning a builder before ownership is authoritatively resolved would invent implementation authority.
risks.mitigation: Keep both work packages blocked and construction authorization false until AI Orchestrator / QN Master resolves OWNER-001.

risks.risk: Adding framework-driven convenience features could expand the canary beyond the approved surface.
risks.mitigation: Treat qn-factory-canary-bot.surface.v0.1 as the complete product contract and reject scope expansion without a new authoritative material review.

unresolved_decisions.question: Which registered downstream unit owns implementation and maintenance of quainhon/qn-factory-canary-bot?

escalation_requirements.reason: The approved XDT1 contract explicitly leaves downstream implementation ownership unresolved.
escalation_requirements.required_resolution: Assign a registered downstream implementation owner with mutation authority for quainhon/qn-factory-canary-bot before XDT3 Construction is activated.

authorization.reason: XDT1 verified the material contract but implementation ownership remains unresolved. XDT2 cannot grant mutation authority or assign TTQN1 ownership.

restrictions: Do not implement product code in XDT2.
Do not mutate quainhon/qn-factory-canary-bot during XDT2.
Keep product scope limited to health, echo, and automated tests.
No authentication, database, queue, scheduler, external integrations, business workflows, or deployment-specific behavior.
Do not activate XDT3 until implementation mutation authority is authoritatively resolved.
